SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
Date January 25, 1933.

Subject (in full) Anniversary of the Death of Lenin (January 21).

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the endorsement of the Officer i/c
Special Branch on the attached report dated January 21, I have
to state that discreet enquiries made by the Chinese staff
of this Section disclose that local millworkers refused to
comply with the instructions issued by representatives of the
Communist Party that they, the workers, should suspend all
work between 11 a.m. and 11.30 a.m. January 21 - the
Anniversary of the Death of Lenin.

The above fact tends to show that local millworkers
have lost faith in the policies of the Chinese Communist Party.

（批：拟）

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
Sd/-

日期：1933年1月25日。

主题（全称）：列宁逝世周年纪念日（1月21日）。

由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）撰写。转呈人 [签名]

关于附后1月21日报告上特务科主管警官的批注，本人谨陈述，经本科华籍职员进行谨慎查访，获悉本地纱厂工人拒绝服从共产党代表发出的指令，即要求工人们于1月21日上午11时至11时30分——列宁逝世周年纪念日——期间停止一切工作。

Date January 21 1933

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting re: Anniversary of the Death of Lenin
(January 21).
Made by D. I. Kuh Pro-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Between 7 and 8.30 p.m. January 20, thirteen labour
representatives of various industrial concerns in the Western
District attended a meeting held in an unnumbered hut at the
rear of the Yung Yu (永豫) Cotton Mill, Western Chapel, under
the auspices of one Siao Zung (小宋), member of the Shanghai
Western Special District Committee of the Chinese Communist
Party. The meeting, which was presided over by Lao Waung
(老王), a leader of the unemployed workers in the Western
District, discussed and passed the following resolutions :-
1) That in accordance with the instructions of the
committeeman of the Shanghai Western Special District Committee,
the demonstrations scheduled to take place on January 21 to
commemorate the Anniversary of the Death of Lenin be postponed
to January 28, the Anniversary of the Outbreak of Sino-Japanese
Hostilities in Shanghai.
2) That all workers in various industrial concerns
suspend work between 11 and 11.30 a.m. January 21 for the
purpose of holding "work-room meetings" to commemorate the
anniversary which will be held under the direction of their
respective "cell" chiefs.

A description of Lao Waung who is reported by
Agents Nos 56711 and 56713 to have presided over the above
gathering is given as follows :-
Age 25, height 5'5", native of Kompo, long face,
sallow complexion, wearing a grey cotton long gown and grey
felt hat.

Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
S2. Further reports re
"A" in due course. MS 21/1/33

日期：1933年1月21日

主题（全称）：关于列宁逝世周年纪念日（1月21日）的共产党会议。
由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pro-hwa）撰写 转呈人 [签名]

1月20日晚7时至8时30分之间，西区各工业企业的十三名劳工代表参加了在西区小教堂永豫（Yung Yu）棉纺厂后面一间无门牌号的棚屋内举行的会议，该会议由中国共产党上海西特别区委员会委员小宋（Siao Zung）主持。会议由西区失业工人领袖老王（Lao Waung）主持，讨论并通过了以下决议：-
1) 根据上海西特别区区委委员的指示，原定于1月21日举行的纪念列宁逝世周年的示威活动推迟至1月28日，即上海中日战事爆发周年纪念日。
2) 各工业企业的所有工人于1月21日上午11时至11时30分停工，目的是在各“细胞”小组负责人的指导下举行“车间会议”以纪念该周年。

据特工第56711号和56713号报告，主持上述集会的老王（Lao Waung）的外貌描述如下：-
年龄25岁，身高5英尺5英寸，高邮（Kompo）人，长脸，面色蜡黄，身穿灰色棉长袍，头戴灰色毡帽。

顾道华（Kuh Tao-hwa）
督察
特务科主管警官。
S2. 有关“A”的进一步报告将适时提交。 MS 1933年1月21日

COPY FOR THE DAILY INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY (19.1.33)

Communist Meeting re : Anniversary of Death of Lenin (Jan. 21)

At a meeting held by certain "Red" adherents in
Chapel on the early morning of January 18, the following
resolutions were passed :-

1) That endeavours be made to advise the masses
to commemorate the anniversary of the death of Lenin
on January 21.

2) That all industrial workers be exhorted
to hold "work-room meetings" in their respective factories
at 11 a.m. on that date.

3) That the venue of commemoration be announced
at a later date.

共产党会议 关于：列宁逝世周年纪念日（1月21日）

在1月18日凌晨，某些“赤色”分子在小教堂举行的一次会议上，通过了以下决议：-

1) 设法劝告民众于1月21日纪念列宁逝世周年。

2) 敦促所有产业工人于当日上午11时在各自工厂举行“车间会议”。

3) 纪念活动的地点将另行公布。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S.2/800pcc
REPORT
Date January 18, 1933.

Subject (in full) Communist meeting in Western Chapel re: Anniversary of the
Death of Lenin (1924) which falls on January 21.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [Signature]

Between 8.30 and 9.30 am. January 18 twelve members of
various communist district committees in Shanghai held a
meeting in a Chinese dwelling, No.7 Chun San Road, to the
rear of the Shanghai Mint, Western Chapel. Lao Sung (老宋),
a representative of the Mutual Aid Society (MOPR) presided over
the meeting. After discussing at length the "Anniversary of
the Death of Lenin," which falls on January 21, the following
resolutions were passed :-

(1) That endeavours be made to advise the masses to
commemorate the anniversary of January 21.

(2) That all industrial workers be exhorted to hold
"work-room meetings" in their respective factories at 11 a.m.
on that date.

(3) That the venue of commemoration be announced at a
later date.

The following is a description of the MOPR representative
Lao Sung who is reported to have presided over the meeting :-
Age about 40; height 5' 6"; native of Hunan; round face;
sallow complexion; dressed in a black cotton long gown.
Further particulars concerning this individual are unavailable,
but a record has been made in our cards for future reference.

The above information was given to the undersigned by
Agents Nos. 56711 and 56713.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

and pass to SI for inclusion in Weekly Intelligence Summary.

Date January 9, 1932

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting held in Western Chapei on January 7, 1933.

Made by D.I. Kuh Fo-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Between 7 and 9 p.m. January 7 eleven members of
the Western District Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
attended a meeting held in a hut off Kwong Foh Road (光復路),
Western Chapei. Siao Lieu (小刘), a representative of the
Mutual Aid Society (MOPR), presided over the meeting. The
following subjects and resolutions were discussed and passed:-
(A) Fundamental measures to consolidate the self-defence
of the Chinese Communist Party
1) That a "detective corps" be organized to investigate
reactionaries and those who cause damage to communist organs
and that attention be paid to their names, addresses, movements
and other particulars.
2) That "Picketing Corps" be organized to safeguard
the organs and other active members of the Party, and that
assistance be rendered to members arrested by the Police.
3) That a "Corps to Attack Running Dogs" be organized
to deal with reactionaries and persons who cause damage to
communist organs and that in case of emergency, members of
this corps assume a self-sacrificing spirit to kill the reactionaries.
(B) Methods to organize the different Corps
1) That persons who are competent to make true
investigations and possess a determined spirit, irrespective of
profession and employment, may voluntarily join the afore-
mentioned corps.
2) That the different corps be organized in groups
of 3, 10, 30 and 50 persons, but that for working purposes, a
unit shall consist of 3 persons only.
The following is a description of Siao Lieu who is
reported to have presided over the meeting :-

主题（全称）：1933年1月7日在闸北西部举行的共产党会议。

由督察顾福华（Kuh Fo-hwa）撰写 转呈人 [签名]

1月7日晚7时至9时之间，中国共产党西区委员会的十一名成员参加了在闸北西部光复路（Kwong Foh Road）附近一间棚屋内举行的会议。互济会（MOPR）代表小刘（Siao Lieu）主持了会议。讨论并通过了以下议题和决议：-
(A) 巩固中国共产党自卫的根本措施
1) 组织“侦探队”，调查反动派及破坏共产党机关的人员，并注意他们的姓名、地址、动向及其他详情。
2) 组织“纠察队”，保卫党的机关和其他活跃党员，并协助被警察逮捕的党员。
3) 组织“打狗队”，对付反动派及破坏共产党机关的人员，并在紧急情况下，该队成员应秉持自我牺牲精神杀死反动派。
(B) 组织各队的方法
1) 无论职业和就业状况如何，凡有能力进行真实调查并具有坚定精神的人，均可自愿加入上述各队。
2) 各队按3人、10人、30人和50人的小组进行组织，但出于工作目的，一个单位仅由3人组成。

Date January 9. 19 33.

Subject (in full) Labour Union's Meeting.

Made by D.S.I. Taplin. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir!
Information has been received to the effect that a labour
union's meeting was held at about 7 p.m. on the 7.1.33 at a straw
hut (No.247) at the back of Yung Yue Filature, North of Soochow
Creek, Jessfield Village by one named Siau Liu, Chairman. 11 men
present. The following suggestions have been approved:-

A. Protection of Union.
1. To organize detective section to investigate any members
of our union for breach of secrets and regulations, and
Anti-union and to record the name and address of those who
commit the above.
2. To organize an examination section to protect our members
and to be responsible for the release of the arrested mem-
bers.
3. To organize a striking dogs section to be responsible for
the killing of those members who are Anti-union, breach of
secrets, etc.

B. Procedure of organizations.
1. Any person employed or unemployed, or students of any
school, members of other union or organ may join the above
sections if willing.

[Signature]
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Signature]

（批：The above meeting was mentioned
in a report by O/C. Kueh dated
9/1/33. Bds. S.T.
